# Only an int variable or a positive integer constant can serve as an explicit
# limit. Computed limits, field limits, zero and non-int limits are left alone.

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
! stderr .
! exists ops_simd.go
cmp ops.go ops.go.orig

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

type T struct{ n int }

func Computed(n int, x, y []float32) {
	for i := 0; i < n+1; i++ {
		y[i] += x[i]
	}
}

func Field(t T, x, y []float32) {
	for i := 0; i < t.n; i++ {
		y[i] += x[i]
	}
}

func Zero(x, y []float32) {
	for i := 0; i < 0; i++ {
		y[i] += x[i]
	}
}

func Narrow(n int32, x, y []float32) {
	for i := range n {
		y[i] += x[i]
	}
}

func LessOrEqual(n int, x, y []float32) {
	for i := 0; i <= n; i++ {
		y[i] += x[i]
	}
}
